name: Cipher
description: Ciphers are uncommon and often misunderstood individuals with extraordinary mental abilities. Like priests and wizards they're able to cast devastating spells, however, ciphers manifest spells through mental prowess alone.
weapons: Club, Crossbow, Dagger, Mace, Shortsword, Shortbow, Spear

traits.bonus: Add a melee or ranged weapon to your proficiency list
Gain advantage on casting one spell you know
+2 to Strength, Dexterity, or Charisma stat
Choose a talent or +2 points to distribute to stats

specials.name: Focused Mind
specials.description: You gain +1 to melee and ranged attacks. In addition, add half your level to these rolls (round down).

spellcasting.name: Psionics
spellcasting.casting: To cast a cipher spell you know, make a spellcasting check by rolling 1d20 + your Charisma modifier. The DC to successfully cast a spell is 10 + the spell's tier.
spellcasting.starting: You know two tier 1 spells of your choice from the cipher spell list as well as the Telekinesis spell (cipher version).
spellcasting.progression: Each time you gain a level, you choose new cipher spells to learn according to the Cipher Spells Known table below.
